mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.user_name, u.user_id FROM post_comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_num = u.user_num WHERE c.post_num = #{postNum} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_pc_num, c.pc_num) ASC, c.pc_created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_num, user_num, pc_content, parent_pc_num) VALUES (#{postNum}, #{userNum}, #{pcContent}, #{parentPcNum})
